short: Llama-AVSR is a strong engineering result but not a new design: VSP-LLM already had a frozen-encoder LoRA LLM decoder; SOTA margins are single-run and under 0.1 WER points.
position: Changed M06 (LLM decoder) and M03 (frozen encoders, LoRA): both standard, since VSP-LLM had the same design first. M12 standard: single runs; the AVSR SOTA rests on margins under 0.1 points.
